Dakshina Tel Mill • Hetauda, Nepal

Our Complete Manufacturing Process

From raw mustard seed receiving and destoning to expeller pressing, settling, and automated pouch packaging.

9-Stage Production Sequence

Manufacturing Timeline

Every single batch follows strict physical and hygienic control parameters from seed intake to final sealed cartons.

01
Weight & Intake

Raw mustard seed receiving

तोरि प्राप्त गर्ने र तौल गर्ने

Receive mustard seeds and record their weight.

Technical Standard

Digital Weighbridge & Moisture Verification

Verified Batch
02
Screening & Destoning

Seed cleaning

तोरि सफा गर्ने

Remove dust, stones, dirt and unwanted materials.

Technical Standard

Multi-Stage Vibratory Sieve & Magnetic Separator

Verified Batch
03
Pre-Processing & Roasting

Seed preparation

तोरि तयार गर्ने

Prepare the cleaned seeds for machine processing.

Technical Standard

Controlled Roasting for Chepuwa / Raw for Cold Pressed

Verified Batch
04
Mechanical Expeller Pressing

Oil extraction

तेल पेल्ने

Feed seeds into the oil expeller and extract mustard oil.

Technical Standard

Continuous Screw Press with Temperature Monitoring

Verified Batch
05
Phase Separation

Thick oil separation

बाक्लो तेल छुट्याउने

Separate the thick oil from the initial extracted oil.

Technical Standard

Gravity Separation & Primary Settling Chambers

Verified Batch
06
Refined Reprocessing

Oil reprocessing

बाक्लो तेल पुनः प्रशोधन गर्ने

Reprocess separated thick oil through the machine as per your production method.

Technical Standard

Secondary Pass to Maximize Natural Yield & Consistency

Verified Batch
07
Settling & Micro-Filtration

Oil settling and filtration

तेल थिग्राउने र छान्ने

Allow suspended particles to settle and filter the oil as required.

Technical Standard

Natural Clarification & High-Density Filter Press

Verified Batch
08
Lab Batch Verification

Quality checking

गुणस्तर जाँच गर्ने

Check appearance, smell, clarity and batch quality.

Technical Standard

Aroma, Free Fatty Acid (FFA) & Clarity Quality Check

Verified Batch
09
500ml & 1L Cartons

Packaging

प्याकिङ गर्ने

Fill 500 ml and 1 litre pouches, seal and pack into cartons.

Technical Standard

Food-Grade Multi-Layer Nitrogen-Sealed Pouches

Verified Batch
